description: Get historical rates over an inclusive date range. Market-dependent rates appear on Frankfurter v1 publication days with both legs available. Statutory euro factors apply to legacy currencies from adoption, with calendar-day rows when a statutory currency is paired with EUR or another active statutory currency. Missing-leg publication days produce coverage notices. summary covers all observations: arithmetic mean, earliest tied extrema, endpoints and percentage change. limit bounds returned rows (default/max 500); 0 returns summary only. Continue inline with next_start_date, the same end_date and a positive limit. Long ranges (>90 days by default) stage beyond the 40,000-character preview budget, independently of limit. canvas_id, or stage: true on a new canvas, always stages the complete series, including short/empty results; either fails without DataCanvas, and an unknown canvas_id fails. Pass the returned canvas_id to stage another series beside it. Each registration preserves earlier tables with a unique table_name. spilled=true returns canvas_id and table_name; use fx_dataframe_describe then fx_dataframe_query for SQL. Without DataCanvas, omit canvas_id and stage to page inline.

base_currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency code (e.g. USD). Call fx_list_currencies to get valid codes.

canvas_id.description: Existing canvas ID from a prior call; stages the complete series on it even for short or empty results, whatever stage says. Every call creates a uniquely named table. Omit it and set stage: true to stage on a new canvas; omit both for automatic staging or inline paging.

end_date.description: ISO 8601 end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be >= start_date. Future dates are not supported.

limit.description: Maximum observations returned in rates, default 500, clamped to 500. Use 0 for summary only; continue inline with a positive limit. Does not affect summary, counts, bounds, staging eligibility or the complete staged table.

quote_currency.description: ISO 4217 quote currency code (e.g. EUR). Call fx_list_currencies to get valid codes.

stage.description: true stages the complete series even when short or empty: on canvas_id when given, otherwise on a new canvas whose canvas_id is returned. To stage another series beside it, pass that canvas_id rather than stage: true again, since fx_dataframe_query reads one canvas at a time. false keeps automatic staging; canvas_id always stages.

start_date.description: ISO 8601 start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Frankfurter v1 data starts 1999-01-04; fixed-only rates start at euro adoption. The first observation can be later than this start.

name: fx_get_timeseries

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID — present when spilled is true. Pass to fx_dataframe_describe to inspect the staged table, then to fx_dataframe_query to run SQL.

end_date.description: Last observation date inside the requested range. Equals the requested end when the series is empty. It can extend beyond the returned preview.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_format`: start_date or end_date is not a real calendar date written as YYYY-MM-DD. `unsupported_currency`: base_currency or quote_currency is not available in the current discovery or served historical data. `date_out_of_range`: start_date precedes 1999-01-04 without an applicable fixed-only rate, or end_date is in the future. `invalid_range`: start_date is after end_date. `upstream_no_data`: Both currencies are supported but Frankfurter v1 has no observation for a requested currency across this range. `canvas_not_found`: An explicitly supplied canvas_id does not exist or has expired. `canvas_unavailable`: canvas_id or stage: true requests staging on a deployment with DataCanvas disabled. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fixed_rates.description: Statutory factors used in the result, present only when a fixed leg was used.

adoption_date.description: First date the statutory factor applies (YYYY-MM-DD).

units_per_eur.description: Statutory units of this currency per EUR.

next_start_date.description: Present only when an inline page was cut short: the first observation date not in rates. Pass it as start_date with the same end_date and a positive limit to get the next page. For limit 0 it is the first observation. Absent on the final page and staged results.

notice.description: Discloses missing currency observations and known coverage bounds, restated historical units, and empty, clamped, paged or staged delivery.

rate_count.description: Total observation days inside the requested range. Includes all observations when rates is truncated. On a continuation it counts observations from that start_date onward.

rate_type.description: Identifies Frankfurter v1 reference rates, statutory euro conversion, or a combination.

rates.description: Date → rate map in date order, observed days inside the requested range only. Bounded by limit (default/max 500), and by the character budget for automatically staged previews. Empty for limit 0 or no observations. Inline partial results continue with next_start_date and a positive limit; staged tables retain every observation.

source.description: Source of the factors used in this result.

spilled.description: True when the complete result was staged on DataCanvas, either explicitly through canvas_id or stage: true, or automatically after exceeding the threshold and preview budget.

start_date.description: First observation date inside the requested range, including when limit is 0. Equals the requested start when the series is empty.

summary.description: Statistics over all observed days in the full clipped requested range before limit, paging or staging; omitted for empty ranges. Missing-leg coverage notices describe excluded served days. Continuations summarize their own requested interval.

change_pct.description: Percentage change from first to last observation.

date.description: Earliest date with the highest rate.

mean.description: Unweighted arithmetic mean of all daily observations in the requested range; not an accounting-policy prescription.

date.description: Earliest date with the lowest rate.

table_name.description: Canvas table name — present when spilled is true. Use it as the FROM target in fx_dataframe_query SQL; fx_dataframe_describe lists its columns.

truncated.description: True when rates holds only part of the series: an inline page (next_start_date continues it) or a spilled preview (spilled is true). False when rates holds every observation in the requested range.

title: Fx Get Timeseries
